title: DOJ lauds Congress approval of Batang Ligtas Act vs. online abuse of children
summary: The Department of Justice (DOJ) lauded Congress’ approval of the Batang Ligtas Act in Congress, which seeks to combat internet grooming and technology-facilitated sexual exploitation.
